_doc: Revert-verify mutant for issue #4438 / ticket a3f3939c on the DIAGNOSTIC (ClassRefNotFoundError). Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). The gate has two deliverables: the refusal (pinned in create-class-resolvable-4438.create.spec.json) and the message that makes the refusal actionable — the caller usually HAS the right first 8 characters, so the `find … -name '<prefix>*.md'` hint is what turns the refusal into a two-second repair. M4 drops that hint while keeping both interpolations referenced (a bare removal would leave `prefix` unused → a compile BROKEN, which is the absence of a measurement, not a measurement). It reds K2 alone; K1 stays GREEN, which is what separates the two deliverables. Recorded runs: see PR body.
